_comment: Layer 1 — Semantic Mapping: English business terms → exact DB column names. Used by LangGraph prompt injection before SQL generation.

filter_hints.BranchAlias: Use LOWER([BranchAlias]) LIKE '%term%' for partial matches. Values like 'CHENNAI MAIN', 'BENGALURU KORAMANGALA'.
filter_hints.CategoryShortName: Use LOWER([CategoryShortName]) LIKE '%term%'. Values like 'FORMAL SHIRTS', 'CASUAL TROUSERS'.
filter_hints.SupplierName: Use LOWER([SupplierName]) LIKE '%term%' for salesperson/staff name filters.
filter_hints.SupplierAlias: Use LOWER([SupplierAlias]) LIKE '%term%' for brand/vendor alias filters.
filter_hints.Color: Use LOWER([Color]) LIKE '%term%'. Values like 'WHITE', 'NAVY BLUE', 'BLACK'.
filter_hints.XnDt: Cast to DATE: CAST([XnDt] AS DATE) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-15'
filter_hints.XnDtMonth: String month label e.g. 'April 2026'. Use LOWER([XnDtMonth]) LIKE '%april%' or GROUP BY [XnDtMonth].

prompt_injection:
CRITICAL COLUMN RULES FOR dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT:
• Revenue/Sales/Turnover        → [MrpValue]          (NEVER SaleNetAmount, SalesNetAmount)
• Quantity/Pieces/Units         → [AppQty]            (NEVER Quantity, SalesQuantity)
• Cost/COGS/Product cost        → [CostValue]         (NEVER CostPrice as metric)
• Net amount after discounts    → [NetAmount]         (exists in view, use when asked)
• Invoice/Bill number           → [XnNo]              (NEVER InvoiceNo, InvoiceId)
• Transaction unique ID         → [XnId]
• Branch/Store/Outlet           → [BranchAlias]
• Salesperson/Staff/Consignee   → [SupplierName]
• Brand alias                   → [SupplierAlias]
• Date column                   → [XnDt]
• Month label (string)          → [XnDtMonth]
• Department                    → [DepartmentShortName]
• Category                      → [CategoryShortName]
• Article/SKU/Product code      → [ArticleNo]
• Color dimension               → [Color]             (NEVER Colour, never SizeName)
• Size dimension                → [Size]              (NEVER SizeName)
• Fabric dimension              → [Fabric]
• Bill/Invoice count            → SUM(ISNULL([BillCount],0)) or COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo])
String filters: always use LOWER([col]) LIKE '%term%'
Aggregations: SUM(ISNULL([MrpValue],0)), SUM(ISNULL([AppQty],0)), SUM(ISNULL([CostValue],0))
RANKING/ALL-TIME queries: NEVER add a date WHERE clause unless the user explicitly asked for a time period.
